items.label: All 11 new RF memories have current public source support
SO-50, AO-91 and AO-123 frequencies/status rechecked against current AMSAT material
French aviation inherited block remains inside current AIRAC 08/26 cycle
Swiss current AIP AIRAC amendment is 06 AUG 2026 and operator frequencies are rechecked
Selected duplex/split analog functions retain both verified RF directions where applicable
No duplicate RF frequency remains after paired-RX expansion
All memory names are unique and at most 10 characters
All generated memories use Duplex=off and Offset=0.000000
No private professional, PPDR or unpublished ADRASEC operational frequency is included
50.5375 MHz is explicitly excluded from v0.3 until a project-wide UV-K5/firmware baseline is guaranteed
Memory total is evidence-driven and not padded
